notes.title: BACK AT IT...
notes.content:
We've returned to Development.
As you all know, this project is the love project of a small, -REAAAALLY SMALL- team of crazy people, and as such many of our team members took a well-deserved rest on December and the first few days of the year, in that time the art team couldn’t stay idle and we decided to make something for the meantime.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251570/Pain_Cage_Tournament/

An interactive visual comic that is even more explicit on adult themes, and possibly the first of many comics to come, so if that sounds interesting, please take a look at the new project (it was a lot easier to do than Slave Fighter, I'll tell you that...) it might be enough entertainment while we finish everything around here.
Everything will help us make a company that makes quality games for adult tastes.
 
Once again, thanks for your patience and your support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40578954/c69b16217700ae0b9108cb9e6954839c7be38582.jpg[/img]

notes.title: About the delays...
notes.content:
It has been a long time now since we were supposed to launch the game. We know that you were expecting it and we want to apologize for it. We hit a roadblock in development; technical issues that would make the experience anything but enjoyable. And because of that, and since this is our only chance to make a first impression, we decided to go way back in order to fix everything broken and deliver the best experience our small team can deliver.

Rest assured, we are hard at work on completing the game as soon as possible and reaching you all with this crazy fantasy!

Bear with us just a little longer, and thanks 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40578954/a8a84693a2ef5438d835b0f93a82f45018a984c8.jpg[/img]for your patience!
